' Establish Revit Journal for ArchitectOS v52.0 IFC4 -> RVT Automatic Conversion
Dim Jrn
Set Jrn = CrsJournalScript
Jrn.Command "Internal" , "Open IFC file , ID_IFC_IMPORT"
Jrn.Data "File Name" , "IDOK", "\tmp\v62_2_build\tests\fixtures\sina_commercial_mezzanine_3d_shell.ifc"
Jrn.Command "Menu" , "Save the active project , ID_REVIT_FILE_SAVE_AS"
Jrn.Data "File Name" , "IDOK", "\tmp\v62_2_build\tests\fixtures\sina_commercial_mezzanine_3d_shell_revit_model.rvt"
Jrn.Command "SystemMenu" , "Quit the application; prompts to save projects , ID_APP_EXIT"
